extractedText: Blood Strike is a first-person shooter battle royale game developed by NetEase Games. Players parachute onto a dangerous battlefield and fight against opponents in a shrinking safe zone. The goal is simple: be the last one standing.As of December 2025, the game has surpassed 100 million downloads. NetEase regularly rewards players by releasing redeem codes that unlock various in-game rewards, including weapon skins, character outfits, game currency, and experience boost items.This article brings you the latest working Blood Strike codes for June 2026, along with a detailed redemption guide. We recommend prioritizing codes with higher value rewards or the ones you need most to get the best benefits.🎁 Claim More Competitive Rewards: While you're at it, don't miss out on free skins for other top-tier titles!Check out the latest Marvel Rivals bundle codes to stand out in the new hero shooter, or grab these LoL redeem codes for the 2026 season.Expired Blood Strike CodesThe following codes were previously active but have now expired or reached their usage limit. We're keeping this list for reference, as there's a small chance these codes might be reactivated during specific holidays or official events.LAUNCHGIFT: Game launch reward code that gave the Glacier Axe permanent weapon skin.BLOODSTRIKE2025: 2025 themed code with random reward package.BLOOD2025: 2025 New Year exclusive code.STRIKE2025MENA: Middle East and North Africa region exclusive code.XMASSTRIKE: 2024 Christmas limited code.How to Redeem Blood Strike CodesFollow these steps to easily redeem your codes:Complete the TutorialAfter entering the game, finish the first tutorial match (about 10 to 15 minutes). Once completed, the system will automatically unlock the main interface and event menu. Otherwise, you might not see the "Redeem Code" option.Open the Event MenuReturn to the main screen and click the "Event" icon on the left side. Sometimes there's a red dot indicating new events. Click it to enter the event overview page.Access the Redemption PageFind the "megaphone" icon on the left side of the event interface and click it, then select "Redemption Code." If you see messages like "Invalid Code" or "Already Redeemed," the code may be expired, already used, or entered incorrectly.Enter and ConfirmType the redeem code in the pop-up box and click “Confirm.”Collect Your RewardsAfter successful redemption, rewards will be automatically sent to your backpack or mailbox. Some items will be credited directly to your account.What Can You Do with Blood Strike Code Rewards?Blood Strike redeem codes unlock various rewards including game currency, weapon skins, character cosmetics, and functional items that both enhance your strength and enrich your gaming experience.Game Currency: Codes often grant Gold, Reputation points, Rank Coins, Strike Coins, and Noble Coins. These currencies can be used to purchase characters, weapon skins, or equipment upgrades in the shop. Noble Coins are rare currency typically obtained through purchases or limited-time events.Weapon and Equipment Skins: Some codes provide permanent or limited edition skins like the AK47-Asuka, MP5-EVA-01, and Glacier Axe. Skins not only change appearances but also come with special kill effects or light effects.Character and Cosmetic Items: Certain codes unlock character outfits, helmets, backpacks, charms, sprays, or emotes, helping players create a more unique look.Functional and Progression Items: These include XP boost cards (speed up character or weapon leveling), room creation tickets (create custom rooms to play with friends), plus random chests and packages containing various rare items.Limited Event Items: Codes released during holiday events or collaboration periods may unlock commemorative badges, avatar frames, or themed decorations.
